stem: How is the information in the selection “Riding Out West” organized overall?

options.label: A
options.text: The cause of the construction of railroads is explained to show why people wanted to travel in West Texas.

options.label: B
options.text: The chronological order of events is used to show how the railroad in West Texas developed over time.

options.label: C
options.text: The description of the different ways people traveled in West Texas is used to highlight the problems with railroads.

options.label: D
options.text: The railroad in West Texas is compared to railroads in other places to show that train travel was popular.
